title: Recognizing the unit step function
description: determine whether u(t) equals 0 or 1 at a given time from its piecewise definition.

title: Identifying the jump at t=0
description: identify t=0 as the jump where the unit step changes abruptly from 0 to 1.

title: Interpreting the unit step as a switch
description: interpret u(t) as turning a signal off before its switching time and on afterward.

title: Reading shifted unit step functions
description: determine the turn-on time of u(t-a) from the shift parameter a.

title: Starting signals with the unit step
description: multiply a signal by u(t) to force it to start at t=0.

title: Converting step-gated signals to piecewise form
description: rewrite a product with a unit step as separate expressions before and after its switching time.

title: Forming rectangular pulses from shifted steps
description: construct a pulse that is one between two times by subtracting shifted unit steps.

title: Restricting signals to finite intervals
description: multiply a signal by u(t-a)-u(t-b) to keep it only on a chosen interval.

title: Decomposing target signals into pieces
description: split a desired waveform into simpler components supported on different time intervals.

title: Writing line equations for signal segments
description: write a line equation from a desired slope and reference point for a signal segment.

title: Building linear segments with step windows
description: combine a line equation with a rectangular step window to realize one segment of a piecewise signal.

title: Combining windowed segments into one signal
description: add separately windowed components to build a complete piecewise waveform.

title: Simplifying step-function signal expressions
description: expand and rearrange grouped windowed terms into a standard sum of shifted-step components.
